Author: Ajay Bhanot

sentences.text: Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Surya Bhan Dubey Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicants have prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
339 of 2022 at Police Station- Cholapur, District- Varanasi under Sections 498A, 304B, IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicants are in jail since 04.10.2022.
The bail application of the applicants was rejected by the learned trial court on 09.01.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Rajesh Pandey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicants,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicants for grant of bail:
(1). The applicant is mother in law of the deceased and the applicant no. 2 is the father in law of the deceased.
(2) The applicants never harassed the deceased nor did Shyama Devi And Another vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127443262/

sentences.text: 1 they ever demand dowry.
(3). The applicants never interfered in the marital life of the deceased.
(4). The applicants are bereaved by the death of their daughter in law.
The deceased was a sensitive lady, who was prone to extreme reactions even over trivial issues.

(5).
On the fateful day she took the extreme step of ending her life in a fit of rage over a minor issue with a member of the household.
The deceased committed suicide by hanging.

(6). The postmortem report opines that;
i. The cause of death as asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.
ii. No abnormality was detected in the trachea and the hyoid bone was intact.
iii. Ligature marks are reference which are consistent with the hanging.
8. The applicants do not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicants are not a flight risk.
The applicants being a law abiding citizen have always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicants- Shyama Devi and Surendra Patel be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicants will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicants will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Pravin  Shyama Devi And Another vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127443262/
